description: Power rule island cells. Positions in blocks. Y scale = cell_size / cell_height. Every site of a case is a cell of the lattice. A wall entry is the wall of the owner toward the other site. A lost owner has null gauge, wall distance, cell radius and island body. An owner outside the row 0 has a null island body. A value matches when |actual - expected| <= tolerance * max(1, |expected|).
